definition-changed.flag: class | of a data item; index
definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.34) gives class by PICTURE/USAGE and (4.102) index as 'A storage area or a register' where 2023 says 'conceptual data item'; a data item of class index in 2002 is still a USAGE INDEX item (an index function, §2002:15.1 item 6, cannot be the receiving identifier-1), so the set of receivers §2002:14.8.35.2 SR3 restricts is unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Triggered by 'arithmetic-expression-1'. §2002:14.8.35.2 SR3 forbids specifying the expression for an index-class receiver; nothing is evaluated, so standard arithmetic (§2002:8.8.1.x, PB5575) cannot change the result; the refusal witness at 2002 stands.
